rules.name: Pass-the-Hash Detection
rules.description: Detects NTLM pass-the-hash attacks where an adversary uses a password hash instead of plaintext password
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
pass_the_hash_events
| where pass_the_hash has_any("lateral-movement", "pass-the-hash", "windows")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold
